def bottom_color(fr):
    b = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    # bottom box interior ~ row 38, cols 29-34
    return b[38][29:35]

    b = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    return b[28][28:36]

    # row 7, cols 34-46
    return ''.join(b[7][c] for c in range(34,47))

print('after purple click: framed=',framed_color(current_frame),'underline=',underline(current_frame))
action(['SPACE'])
print('after SPACE: bottom=',bottom_color(current_frame),'framed=',framed_color(current_frame))
b=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print('bottom box rows 34-43:')
for r in range(34,44):
    print(r,''.join(b[r][c] for c in range(25,40)))
</parameter>
</function>
